title: Electric Toothbrushes: Oscillating, Sonic and Budget
metaDescription: Our electric toothbrush research: the best brushes from basic to fully featured, and how to choose between oscillating and sonic.
lede: A good electric toothbrush doesn't need dozens of modes. A timer, a pressure sensor and a brush head you'll actually replace matter most.

p: Start with the best electric toothbrushes list, or read the buying guide if you're deciding between oscillating and sonic brushes.
